product_benchmark_full_ridge: Shadow-only challenger is unstable across seeds and is not deployed; production default remains unchanged
anticipation_simulator: component fixture simulator with intentionally permissive setup; mandatory regression smoke but never used as product benchmark evidence
confidence_semantics: presence probability, forecast uncertainty, expected action utility, data coverage, empirical policy quality, preference alignment and decision strength remain distinct runtime quantities
startup: http-first; initial HA snapshot/context ingestion completes before the background inference gate opens
startup_ingress: HTTP/runtime readiness gets a 3 s head start before the first proactive all-agent inference pass; realtime changes observed during the grace remain dirty and are processed afterwards
ui_polling: polling_guard coalesces duplicate GETs; Candidate lifecycle polling now matches the 4 s main UI cadence instead of adding a 1.5 s Raspberry Pi status/DB poller; candidate-live suppresses requests when no Candidate exists; mutations bypass read brokers.
training_cpu_budget: explicit historical Train/Rebuild targets 20% cooperative duty cycle with a 50 ms continuous-work slice; legacy shipped defaults 25%/75 ms migrate automatically
training_cpu_budget_note: application-level cooperative wall-clock budget, not a Linux cgroup hard quota; an individual blocking SQLite call can exceed the target before the next checkpoint, and real Raspberry Pi verification remains required
ui_lifeline: periodic /api/status and /api/agents use complete revision-cached agent configs plus hot runtime without history aggregates; PAUSED/WAITING/NEEDS_RETRAIN configs are separate from the inference-routing subset; Home Intelligence diagnostics are RAM-backed and TTL-cached.
queue_lifeline: queue display-name resolution uses get_agent_config instead of aggregate history scans
rpi_low_power: background adaptive-ai-history remains on its separate 20% default duty cycle; explicit training now targets 20% plus 50 ms work slices
recorder_backoff: a discovery Recorder timeout opens the 120 s circuit breaker, but coverage is paused rather than skipped; the same resilient request/split path resumes after cooldown
automation_scan: the first background pass suppresses config scan; later automation config reads are serialized and last successful scan time is persisted
release_016_guard: installed after startup_train_guard; quiet startup/background scheduling only
release_017_lifeline: installed after release_016_guard and before core.main; read-side availability and training scheduling only, no model/label/history/generation mutation
migration: no destructive migration; existing agents, models, feedback, raw archive, historical experiences, candidate lineage, rollback and generation state preserved
physical_control: unchanged; repaired agents return to Shadow and Control still requires qualified state plus all existing guards
pi4: 0.14.38 targets the long-soak Raspberry Pi failure: drift analysis is coalesced on a throttled background observer, REST /states reconciliation is delta-only after bootstrap, websocket outage fallback reconciles every 10 s, and HA core-state health is tracked separately from unrelated REST errors.
ci_status: 0.14.52 release-head validation pending on Python 3.11 and 3.13.
training_slice_budget: adaptive-ai-index workers call a shared CooperativeTrainingBudget; expensive temporal tracker loops yield between entities/events and finalization is no longer outside the throttle
finalization_lifeline: HEAVY_JOBS remains owned through final gc.collect(), so /api/status and /api/agents stay on lightweight lifeline reads until the worker is actually finished
finalization_progress: post-replay UI now exposes bounded stages: replay complete, policy serialization, benchmark save, qualification, checkpoint complete
benchmark_finalization: set_partial_benchmark uses get_agent_config instead of history COUNT/AVG aggregates
ui_mutation_stability: confidence diagnostics use idempotent DOM writes and observe only direct #agents child replacement; the body-wide subtree MutationObserver self-loop from 0.14.18 is removed
browser_reproduction: source-level regression: the body-wide subtree observer could observe confidence textContent writes performed by its own callback; 0.14.19 removes that self-triggering feedback path
post_training_lifecycle: completed persisted policies enter Shadow whether or not Control qualification passed; non-qualified policies remain training_state=paused and cannot enter Control
settings_lifecycle_controls: agent Settings exposes explicit Shadow and Pause actions; Shadow requires an existing learned model and an inactive rebuild/training state
model_contract_restart: storage bootstrap treats v10/schema11 and newer as modern structural formats; exact current compatibility remains owned by observation_contract
model_contract_repair: current v11/schema12 models incorrectly left in needs_retrain by 0.14.21 restart are restored only when recorded-behaviour benchmark evidence remains intact
model_contract_repair_safety: genuine config invalidation clears benchmark evidence and is never auto-repaired
interactive_correct_admission: Apply Correct persists a client-supplied idempotency key and returns 202 before Candidate orchestration; processing requests recover to accepted after restart
interactive_correct_ui: Correct opens from the rendered card before workflow status/history reads; a pending request ID survives HTTP response loss in sessionStorage and is polled instead of blindly resubmitted
candidate_shadow_heartbeat: The 30 s passive Candidate heartbeat may re-observe the same HA state revision. Revision dedupe remains enabled for duplicate state_changed requests but no longer suppresses quiet-home heartbeat freshness.
candidate_card_decision_freshness: Candidate cards always show the last actually observed Parent Desired and Candidate Desired. The 95 s freshness windows remain explicit metadata and no longer blank last-known card values.
candidate_card_pairing_metadata: parent_decision_paired reports whether the currently displayed Parent/Candidate observations share one event id; paired A/B scoring and promotion evidence remain same-event-only.
candidate_card_last_decision: UI and backend retain the last real observed decision for the same generation across sparse payloads, quiet periods and freshness expiry; restart performs one cold read then returns to RAM-first polling.
correct_candidate_chart: Sparse observed Candidate/Parent Desired samples render as step-state evidence through the existing 95 s validity window; expiry still creates a real runtime gap and no policy replay is used.
correct_candidate_overlap: Direct Parent and Candidate Desired use distinct dash patterns and the Correct status line reports separate Current/Parent/Candidate point counts so identical predictions remain diagnosable.
training_queue_priority: Teach/Correct Candidate (interactive) > explicit user Train/Rebuild/Resume > maintenance; auto-discovery never enqueues first-model training; FIFO inside each explicit class; an already active heavy job is not preempted
stage1_performance_scope: admission, UI resilience and queued-work priority only; historical replay/model/reward semantics are unchanged
replay_persistence: historical_experiences are deduplicated in memory and persisted in bounded 64-row default batches before model watermark advancement
replay_crash_safety: existing model _history_watermark remains authoritative; failed passes discard all experience rows committed after the previous model checkpoint
feature_screening: broad precursor screening runs only while a policy schema is unresolved; persisted model schemas and explicit Teach/Correct/manual input selections bypass the full scan
feature_screening_yield: target-edge precursor fan-out has an explicit cooperative training-budget checkpoint in addition to archive iterator checkpoints
stage2_performance_scope: SQLite replay write batching plus schema-aware/incremental feature-screening lifecycle; policy/reward/qualification semantics unchanged
feature_screening_stream: SQLite LAG emits only effective per-entity state/attribute changes to Python; fast occupancy/activity driver rows stay raw and bounded
replay_provenance: target-row provenance is preloaded in one indexed query; accepted/excluded replay audit facts are persisted in bounded batches, preserving own-command exclusion without per-dwell reads/commits
temporal_replay_contract: selected-input replay uses two bounded incremental cursors: first access/rewind is indexed bulk as-of reconstruction; forward advance consumes only newly eligible rows; same timestamp performs zero SQLite reads
temporal_replay_memory: maximum 64 selected-input samples per entity; bulk SQL is deliberately chunked to 32 entities to bound individual SQLite/GIL-visible work slices on Raspberry Pi
temporal_replay_home_semantics: room-belief features preserve the previous exact 30-second causal rebuild semantics while replacing one seed query per home source with indexed bulk LIMIT queries
temporal_replay_observation_semantics: feature-observation replay remains gated by both event_time and received_time; late packets become visible only after receipt and same-timestamp v12 merge behavior is preserved
temporal_replay_scheduling: onset/anticipation and dwell-persistence use separate cursors; requested timestamps are processed oldest-first inside each role to reduce non-semantic rewinds
temporal_replay_diagnostics: history status exposes SQL queries, rows loaded, forward advances, rewinds, bulk rebuilds, same-timestamp hits and estimated query reduction
stage3_performance_scope: temporal reconstruction/query topology only; reward, policy/schema versions, qualification, provenance, feedback and physical-control semantics are unchanged
temporal_replay_ordering: archive-only replay preserves integer entity_history id ordering on equal timestamps; observation-contract replay preserves the established v12 event/received/string-id merge ordering
startup_http_readiness: runtime_available remains internal construction semantics; user-facing agent/live APIs require startup.ready so half-built Engine state cannot appear as missing Shadow predictions
startup_index_qos: F22 no longer creates redundant entity_history(entity_id,ts,id); the existing entity_id,ts index already carries rowid/id as the implicit tie-breaker
stage4_performance_scope: startup/runtime readiness and interactive QoS only; no model/reward/evidence/qualification semantics changed
correct_history: live Correct chart/point reads observed target state + decision_history directly; no RL policy replay on the HTTP path
realtime_training_preemption: fresh HA events request 0.75 s priority; the debounced realtime inference pass extends it by 1.0 s; Correct history/point use 1.0 s and Correct label signature reconstruction uses 2.0 s; historical worker yields at checkpoints
room_belief_replay_cache: forward chronological replay keeps a moving 30 s in-memory source window and advances per-entity seeds instead of re-reading every seed from SQLite
telemetry_recent_p95: telemetry exposes recent_p95_ms over the last 60 s; hot /api/status again includes TELEMETRY.snapshot() so event->intent p95 remains visible without Engine.status aggregates.
stage5_performance_scope: Correct read path, Room Belief replay caching, realtime priority and latency observability; learning/control semantics unchanged
product_benchmark_topology_contract: sensor_moved changes the future Entity Registry area mapping for the same entity_id and the changed mapping is passed into every evaluated runtime
product_benchmark_manual_override_contra: manual_change emits explicit target provenance with context.user_id; fast targets now delegate to the authoritative Engine manual-hold path. F24 v2 measures zero manual_override_violations and runtime_manual_hold_ticks_mean=115 across seeds 11,23,37 without changing benchmark thresholds or scenario logic
product_benchmark_report_artifact: GitHub Actions run 35439656239 uploads product-benchmark-f24-py311/product-benchmark-f24.json for the unchanged 3-seed composed-runtime run
product_benchmark_unmet_criteria_status: GitHub Actions run 35439656239 on unchanged F24 v2 leaves only needed_light_not_worse_than_fixed_by_more_than_2pp unmet
product_benchmark_control_qualification: all 3 seeds pass the unchanged 78% per-action Wilson lower-bound gate; lowest per-action lower bound is 82.52% for seeds 11,23,37
manual_priority_fast_runtime: fast light/switch/input_boolean targets retain short action/settling/ack timing and authoritative explicit_user_v8 manual hold; the new light-only statistical OFF confirmation never delays a physical manual OFF
feature_contract_compatibility: persisted schema v12 models without feature_contract_version remain contract v1; fresh/rebuilt models use v2, so existing vectors are never reinterpreted
fast_light_photometric_contract: v2 removes own-action lux leakage: when a light is ON, illuminance uses a causal pre-action ambient baseline when available; unresolved startup ON remains unknown
fast_light_health_feature_contract: v2 centres nominal fast-light validity/transport-quality metadata so repeated healthy columns do not accumulate OFF class-frequency bias
fast_light_off_confirmation: historical_policy_bootstrap OFF from an already-ON light must remain continuously recommended for 6 s; ON stays immediate and manual/scoped-instruction/preference/experiment OFF bypasses confirmation
startup_inference_gate: background Engine inference is closed during runtime composition and opens only after startup.ready; first proactive inference is deferred 3 s to preserve Ingress responsiveness
realtime_inference_workers: device-control ThreadPoolExecutor is capped at min(2, os.cpu_count()) to reduce Python/GIL contention on Raspberry Pi while retaining limited overlap for I/O.
initial_snapshot_inference: initial REST snapshot is context/history warm-up, not a realtime transition; it no longer marks every entity dirty and therefore does not force a startup all-agent event burst
event_driven_inference: HA state changes trigger relevant agents immediately; the 1 s engine tick is timer scheduling only and no longer runs every eligible agent
inference_idle_heartbeat: fast and slower targets default to 30 s idle heartbeat; HA events and exact OFF-confirmation, ACK, outcome, retry and manual-hold deadlines still wake agents immediately.
inference_event_fanout: events wake target/schema/explicit-input/same-area RoomBelief dependencies only; a presence sensor in another room no longer wakes every agent in the house
empty_wakeup_contract: exactly one complete post-startup inference pass; later empty wakeups and unchanged REST resyncs never mean process-all
manual_hold_cpu: while an explicit manual hold is active, periodic policy recomputation is suppressed until hold expiry unless an earlier lifecycle deadline exists
inference_scheduler_observability: status exposes event_passes, timer_passes, idle_skips, initial_full_passes and last_timer_targets
post_recorder_discovery: auto-discovery no longer opens one archive iterator per target/property; one bounded multi-target archive stream computes usage-equivalent change counts
post_recorder_archive_stats: full-table archive_stats COUNT(DISTINCT)/GROUP BY is removed from the 65% post-Recorder critical path
discovery_cpu_budget: single discovery archive stream now remains inside the existing Raspberry-Pi background archive throttle instead of repeatedly resetting it across many short iterators
discovery_agent_reads: quiet startup and auto-discovery use list_agent_configs instead of aggregate list_agents reads when reward/history statistics are not required
websocket_keepalive_note: keepalive ping timeouts are treated as CPU/GIL starvation symptoms; websocket timeout thresholds are unchanged
operational_first: normal startup serves saved agents + realtime only; Recorder backfill, auto-discovery and heavy historical work are not automatic background duties
discovery_activation: device discovery/Recorder refresh runs only after explicit Rescan devices and executes on a background worker, never inside the HTTP request thread
periodic_ui_reads: periodic /api/status and /api/agents use revision-invalidated in-memory agent configs and hot runtime; an empty agent set is cacheable, and only a 10 minute safety fallback may rescan agents for unsupported external/direct DB edits.
background_maintenance: automatic periodic Recorder/discovery disabled in normal runtime; realtime ingestion keeps current events flowing; explicit maintenance remains available
recovery_rationale: post-0.14.11 architecture accumulated large layered runtime changes; this release removes heavy automatic work from the steady-state path instead of adding further throttling
agent_hot_path_routing: entity->agent dependency routing and agent configs are cached in RAM; each coalesced event pass shares one state/revision snapshot and process_target does not reread agent config.
shadow_executor_hot_path: positively identified Shadow intents bypass durable Control revalidation; Control continues to reread durable config and enforce every physical-dispatch guard.
preference_hot_path: manual-feedback preference facts are revision-invalidated and cached in RAM; agents without feedback skip preference signature construction and SQL.
candidate_shadow_hot_path: no active Candidate means no Candidate inference; generation discovery including empty state is invalidation-driven and paired A/B summary updates are O(1).
provenance_hot_path: Shadow decision provenance and feature evidence windows are deferred/batched; target-event origin and active command echo evidence are served from RAM after startup hydration.
feature_observation_hot_path: high-resolution feature observations are queued in bounded RAM and persisted in batches outside HA event->intent; queue backlog is exposed in hot status and bounded under SQLite stalls.
teach_rebenchmark_hot_path: inactive Teach rebenchmark short-circuits before durable config reads; SQLite refresh is limited to the short active post-Teach qualification lifecycle.
paused_shadow_scheduler: paused Shadow extends inference eligibility only and no longer replaces Engine.process/process_target, preserving the optimized scheduler.
storage_profile: microSD-aware RAM-first transient persistence; durable Control/command/model/explicit-feedback boundaries remain synchronous while diagnostic/replay evidence is coalesced.
sqlite_runtime: SQLite temp_store=MEMORY, cache_size=-16384 (~16 MiB page cache), mmap_size up to 64 MiB when supported; WAL + synchronous=NORMAL retained.
diagnostic_event_buffer: latest 5000 events are served from RAM; up to 4096 pending diagnostics batch at 64 rows or ~5 s, errors may force prompt durability; /api/events does not poll SQLite after startup warm-up.
provenance_event_buffer: current HA event provenance is cached in RAM (bounded 8192) and batch-persisted by the background writer; historical replay is an explicit durability boundary and flushes pending provenance before indexed joins.
feature_journal_buffer: feature observations/evidence windows remain bounded in RAM and coalesce for up to 2 s; larger batches are 512 observations / 128 windows with overload fallback preserving evidence.
decision_history_buffer: prediction/decision history auto-flush is 256 rows or ~5 s; explicit flush remains available for durability boundaries.
live_archive_buffer: live entity archive auto-flush is 128 rows or ~5 s; explicit flush remains available for bootstrap/shutdown boundaries.
agent_config_cache: two revision-invalidated RAM views are maintained: all_agent_configs for UI/lifecycle visibility and agent_configs for inference-eligible routing only; an empty set is cacheable and the 600 s fallback is only for unsupported external/direct SQLite edits.
context_shadow_persistence: Sensor Tournament residual models are authoritative in RAM during runtime and deduplicated per agent/challenger; a background writer persists dirty snapshots at up to 5 s intervals or a 32-key pressure threshold.
fast_light_persistence: fast-light benchmark metrics and weight-only learning checkpoints are RAM-first and deduplicated per agent; the background writer persists metrics and latest model snapshots in batches at up to 5 s intervals.
schema_age_diagnostics: schema-age rows are hydrated once and remain RAM-only while revision/signature is unchanged; SQLite is updated only when the schema identity changes.
candidate_status_read_path: Candidate status/comparison, confidence and promotion-validation decorators use config-only agent reads; list_status evaluates each Candidate edge once and never runs rl_feedback/historical_experiences COUNT/AVG aggregates merely to render cards.
home_intelligence_status: operational /api/status now returns the real in-memory ContextEngine/HomeBootstrap diagnostics instead of the accidental empty placeholders introduced by the 0.14.17 lifeline; rich Home Intelligence diagnostics are TTL-cached for 5 s.
hot_status_locking: RAM backlog gauges are intentionally approximate and read queue lengths without waiting for Store/teaching persistence locks, so a long microSD transaction cannot turn diagnostics into a 12 s UI timeout.
candidate_ui_polling: 0.14.36 accidentally emitted literal \\n characters inside a JavaScript line comment, so the Candidate polling loop was commented out while remaining syntactically valid. 0.14.37 restores real newlines and an executable 4 s Candidate refresh loop.
ui_read_isolation: main agent cards and Recent activity now use Promise.allSettled; a stalled /api/events read can no longer discard a successful /api/agents refresh or leave Desired/inference tiles stale.
diagnostic_event_locking: diagnostic event RAM buffers use a dedicated _event_lock; /api/events never waits for the global Store transaction lock, and opportunistic diagnostic persistence uses a nonblocking Store-lock acquisition.
ha_connectivity_semantics: hot status separates HA reachability (successful REST/HA client state) from realtime WebSocket connectivity; agent cards explicitly receive the current websocket state instead of defaulting to REST fallback when the field is absent.
ha_state_resync: Healthy realtime keeps a 300 s safety snapshot; after bootstrap only changed entities update context, temporal history and archive. WebSocket loss switches temporarily to a 10 s delta-only REST fallback.
ha_health_contract: HA connected means either an authenticated realtime websocket or a successful dedicated /states snapshot. History, automation-config or service-call failures do not redefine core HA reachability.
drift_observer_runtime: Controlled-drift episode ingestion/detection runs outside device-control inference, reads only unseen EpisodeEvaluator suffixes in bounded batches, uses bounded detection windows and does not re-signal an already pending agent inside the 30 s throttle.
pi_degradation_diagnostics: Home Intelligence exposes recent process CPU, inference/event scheduler counters, drift observer run/pending/max duration and state-resync changed-count/last/max duration.
clean_install_discovery: During Recorder import, active-device classification is explicitly reported as pending instead of zero. Duplicate Rescan requests are idempotent and the UI disables the button while discovery is already running.
discovery_cpu_scope: No incremental archive rescans were added. Activity classification still runs once after the bounded Recorder target import, preserving the Raspberry Pi CPU/IO budget.
cold_start_training: Initial agent training now uses one indexed chronological archive stream for both raw fast-driver evidence and effective-change precursor screening. It reports scan progress from the first rows instead of waiting behind a SQLite LAG/PARTITION window query.
realtime_training_fairness: Continuous HA state traffic can no longer renew strict training preemption forever. Realtime priority is burst-capped at 1.25 s followed by a 0.10 s cooldown, guaranteeing bounded training slices while retaining short realtime latency protection.
training_queue_lifecycle: TrainingQueue semantics are unchanged: one active heavy agent job at a time; completion releases HEAVY_JOBS and the queue automatically starts the next job. The fix restores forward progress of the active worker rather than bypassing queue safety.
initial_discovery: fresh install scans the full configured activity window once; older state/value history uses minimal no-attribute Recorder reads, while attribute-only targets use bounded full-state history
discovery_training_boundary: discovery creates WAITING/PAUSED agents only; first model starts only after explicit Train
discovery_ui_refresh: completed discovery reads /api/agents with a per-run discovery_revision cache key so the rendered card list cannot reuse the pre-discovery polling cache
discovery_activity_threshold: fresh-install discovery and manual Rescan use threshold_override=1
discovery_upgrade_reconciliation: 0.14.41 and older installs missing discovery_deep_history_complete receive exactly one post-ready deep_history_reconcile pass; later restarts remain quiet
discovery_diagnostics: status exposes reason counts plus up to 24 inactive-target examples: no_transition, below_threshold, stale_transition and registry filtering; UI shows full/recent discovery-window state and reason totals
train_ui_layering: generation workflow may replace the P0 action row; retained-card P0 refresh treats missing legacy action controls as intentional and null-safe
train_admission_boundary: successful POST /api/agents/{id}/train is final queue admission; a later UI refresh/render exception is logged and retried instead of being shown as Train failed
training_progress_contract: HistoryManager exposes continuous whole-job progress separately from local Recorder/screening/replay stage counters; the active card receives the in-memory global progress without extra SQLite writes.
training_eta_contract: Whole-training ETA is estimated from real wall-clock end-to-end progress and therefore includes Recorder waits, Pi-safe throttling, replay chunks and finalization; stage ETA remains separately available.
training_queue_ui_refresh: TrainingQueue exposes a monotonic lifecycle revision; start/finish/queue transitions force a cache-bypassing /api/agents read so completed and newly-active cards refresh on the next UI poll.
paused_agent_actions: A trained PAUSED card exposes Start Shadow plus Resume training; Shadow can be paused again. The last-loaded runtime decorator defensively restores these lifecycle actions if another renderer replaces them.
training_performance_policy: Pi-safe CPU duty cycle remains 20% with 50 ms max continuous work slice; this release improves observability/lifecycle correctness without risking renewed HA/UI degradation.
shadow_mode_ui: mode PATCH success is separated from post-mutation render refresh; renderer exceptions cannot relabel a successful Paused->Shadow transition as failure
candidate_event_contract: active Candidate generations have an in-memory dependency index and passive state_changed fallback on the Candidate worker; the websocket callback only queues work
candidate_event_dedup: normal Parent inference remains authoritative; passive fallback is suppressed when the same/newer Engine state revision already produced Candidate Shadow
candidate_heartbeat: persistent Candidate Shadow receives a bounded 30-second passive heartbeat when Parent inference is absent; heartbeat does not self-wake/spin on an untrained Candidate
candidate_safety: passive Candidate events infer Candidate policy only; they never construct ActionIntent, touch Executor or send Home Assistant services
candidate_pairing: passive Candidate-only observations use candidate-passive event IDs and never borrow an unrelated Parent Desired; paired A/B evidence still requires a shared Parent+Candidate prediction event
candidate_live_read_contract: The 1-second Candidate tile path reads Current from Engine.state_map and Candidate/Parent decision snapshots from in-memory Candidate runtime; SQLite is restart/backfill only after the runtime is warm.
candidate_ab_edge_cache: The active direct Parent/Candidate comparison edge is cached in RAM and invalidated by Candidate lifecycle mutations instead of querying SQLite on every physical target transition.
candidate_membership_cache: Hidden Candidate and retained lineage surrogate IDs are held in a RAM set and refreshed only on lifecycle mutations/pruning.
candidate_root_config_cache: Passive Candidate observation prefers Engine.all_agent_configs for root configuration; active policy schema reads prefer Engine.models.
persistence_boundary: Raw history, feedback, learned model checkpoints, benchmarks and Candidate evidence remain durable; the new caches are acceleration state only.
ram_policy: Do not duplicate mutable RL model graphs in a second Store cache: active policies already live in Engine.models. RAM is used where it removes SQLite I/O without creating model coherency risk.
training_window: Explicit Train/Rebuild uses a rolling 7-day window anchored to current time; old persisted windows are clamped forward on Resume.
training_resource_policy: Explicit agent training has zero fixed inter-chunk pause, 55% cooperative duty cycle, 35 ms max continuous work slices, 0.5 s max throttle sleep, and HA state_changed retains strict interactive preemption.
background_history_policy: Discovery/background Recorder imports retain the 1500 ms background pause; only explicit selected-agent training uses the zero-pause path.
correct_current_contract: Physical Current is event-state persistence, not a stale prediction: seed state is projected to the chart start, last known state to the chart end, and the renderer does not apply Desired's stale timeout to Current.
candidate_event_root_contract: All Candidate generations route passive realtime observation through durable lineage root_agent_id, so Gen2/Gen3+ do not lose events when direct parent is a Candidate surrogate.
training_schema_cache: Explicit Rebuild captures the previous policy schema and selection metadata in RAM before clearing learning; learned heads are reset and the seed is usable only while that agent has an active training job.
training_screening_scope: When no reusable schema exists, feature screening scans only policy-admissible context candidates plus the target instead of every archived entity.
training_replay_ram_cache: Onset and persistence temporal trackers share a per-job bounded LRU for exact repeated small history queries; default cap 8192 rows and 1024 rows per entry.
indexed_incremental_replay: FeatureJournal forward replay now uses disjoint event_time and received_time range scans with an entity+received_time index; exact causal top-64 semantics are preserved while empty increments avoid walking old retained history.
sensor_quality_sql_fix: Includes PR #130 fix: context_tournament_sensor_quality INSERT now has 12 placeholders for 12 columns, restoring durable shadow quality updates.
